content:
Connor O'Brien: Heads up: starting canary for **Hosted circuit breakers + load shedding** in **us-east** today.

Scope (canary):
- Region: us-east
- Traffic: ~5% of Hosted API requests
- Routes: `POST /v1/chat/completions` + `POST /v1/embeddings` (hosted)
- Models: `llama-3.1-70b-instruct` + `bge-large-en`
- Feature flag: `overload_protection_v1` (per route/model)

What to watch for (expected vs not):
✅ Expected under bursts:
- More **429/503** responses with **Retry-After** + Redwood error codes (instead of timeouts)
- Slightly higher shed rate during step-function load tests

🚫 Not expected / please escalate:
- Breaker flapping (open/close rapidly) or sustained OPEN when traffic normal
- Any sustained increase in **5xx timeouts** (as opposed to explicit overload errors)
- Streaming disconnect spikes on chat (if you see this, drop details)
- p99 latency regression > ~15% without corresponding shed increase

Dashboards / links:
- Overload protection dashboard (us-east): https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/overload-protection?var_region=us-east
- SLO view (Hosted API): https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/hosted-slo
- Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SRE/Hosted+Overload+Mitigation+Runbook
- Rollout ticket: ENG-4834

Where to report:
- If customer impact / suspected incident: post in #incidents and tag @Rafael Mendes @Christine Wong
- If “weird but not paging”: drop details in #eng-sre with request IDs / region / route / model

Key details to include in any report:
- region, route, model, status code, `x-redwood-error-code` (if present), and `retry-after` value
- sample request_id(s) + approximate time window

We’ll keep the canary up for a few hours, then decide expand/rollback. :eyes:

[reactions: :eyes: 18, :thumbsup: 24]

DeployBot: Change applied: feature flag `overload_protection_v1` enabled (scope=hosted, region=us-east, routes=chat+embeddings, models=llama-3.1-70b-instruct|bge-large-en, traffic=5%).

Sean Gallagher: +1 — goal here is to **fail fast and clearly** during overload instead of melting into ambiguous 5xx + tail latency collapse. If you’re oncall anywhere adjacent (gateway/routing/runtime), keep an eye on p99 + breaker transitions. Thanks Connor.

Rafael Mendes: For folks watching along: the main signals we’re using to judge “healthy canary” are
- breaker_state transitions by (model,tier)
- shed_rate by layer (edge vs routing vs runtime)
- %timeouts (should go *down*)
- control plane latency (routing svc)

If you see breaker_state thrash, pls include a screenshot of the breaker panel + the time range.

Christine Wong: One nuance: you may see some customers say “why am I getting 429 now?” That’s expected for overload-protected behavior. 429/503 with `Retry-After` + code is preferred to long-hanging requests.

If you see 429 without Retry-After header, that’s a bug — please flag.

Amara Diallo: Gateway side is mapping overload reasons to consistent payloads now. If you’re debugging, look for:
- header: `x-redwood-overload-layer: edge|routing|runtime`
- header: `x-redwood-error-code: ...`

Also, pls sanity check that OpenAI-compat endpoints look consistent for the canary paths.

Aisha Bello: Alerts are *not* paging on overload-protected errors during the canary (by design). We’re watching a private canary board + will page if we see internal 5xx or control plane issues.

Sergio Costa: If anyone wants a quick view: I added a temporary panel “429/503 split (overload vs other)” on the dashboard link Connor posted. Should help distinguish intentional shedding vs accidental rate limit spikes.

Allison Grant: Reminder on metrics: please avoid pasting/creating ad-hoc labels with request_id in Prometheus queries we share around. If you need correlation, use traces/logs via request_id, not metrics labels.

Nikhil Sharma: Product note: Support already has draft guidance for customers on Retry-After + backoff. If you see an account getting surprised, route them to Support and we’ll send the FAQ + recommended retry snippet.

Nora Ahmed: For comms: we’re *not* posting anything public for a canary. If we have to do active shedding beyond canary scope, loop me in and I’ll prep status-page language (keeping it customer-actionable, no internals).

Incident Bot: If you believe this is causing customer impact, please post in #incidents with:
- severity guess (Sev2/Sev3)
- affected regions/models
- example request IDs
- current breaker_state screenshot

Connor O'Brien: Quick pulse check ~45 min in: shed_rate up a bit during internal load test window, but timeouts down. No rollback signals so far. Keep reports coming here or in #eng-sre.

[reactions: :white_check_mark: 12, :chart_with_upwards_trend: 6]
